columnWidth.description: Sets the initial pixel width for the spreadsheet columns.

resizable.description: If true, allow column to be resized when hovering over the vertical border line between the column headers.

valueFormatSpec.description:
The configs for how to display the numerical values in the grid.
To provide date level formatting, check {@link UiCollapsibleGridTreeNodeDatum#format}.
By default the numbers will display without formating.
This will be overridden by a {@link UiCollapsibleGridTreeNode row} or
{@link UiCollapsibleGridTreeNodeDatum cell} format spec.
It's essential to understand that the format specification provided here applies
to all numerical values within the row. So, if a date is provided as a value in milliseconds,
it will be formatted as a number unless accompanied by a [date format](UiCollapsibleGridTreeNodeDatum#format).
Therefore, to avoid such cases its recommended to specify dates as either an ISO 8601 string or a localized string.

treeGroupings.description:
List containing grouping applied to data in the tree grid. This
field needs to be populated correctly in order to allow correct export
of grid as flattened csv.

legendItems.description: Mapping between color and label to pass information via props and populate {@link UiCollapsibleGrid} legend.
